title: Add clap dep to kith-tui Cargo.toml
description:
What: Add clap 4 with derive feature to kith-tui/Cargo.toml.

Algorithm:
1. Check workspace Cargo.toml for existing clap entry. If present as workspace dep, add clap.workspace=true; else add clap = { version = "4", features = ["derive"] } directly to kith-tui/Cargo.toml [dependencies].
2. Run cargo check -p kith-tui to verify the dep resolves without conflicts.

Defensive programming rules:
- No other changes to any other file.

Agent team: R reads Cargo.toml files; I makes the dep edit; T runs cargo check; V runs cargo test -p kith-tui.

Tests: cargo check -p kith-tui exits 0.
